raw_text: 尼泊尔与中国签署跨喜马拉雅铁路框架协议，连接吉隆口岸与加德满都。Nepal and China signed a framework agreement for the trans-Himalayan railway, a landmark project under the Belt and Road Initiative. The railway will connect Kerung in Tibet Autonomous Region to Kathmandu, with China providing USD 3.5 billion in financing. Both sides expressed confidence in the project's feasibility.
clean_text: Nepal-China trans-Himalayan railway framework agreement signed under BRI. Kerung to Kathmandu. USD 3.5B Chinese financing. Both sides confident in feasibility.
